Hi Elaine / Victor —

Thanks again for agreeing to host the executive workshop in London. I wanted to get the preflight conversation started so we can lock logistics and avoid last-minute AV surprises. High-level asks below — can you confirm by end of week?

Preferred dates (our suggestions): Aug 17–18 or Aug 24–25. Which set works for your team?

Key info we need from you:
- Headcount (onsite + remote attendees)
- Two primary POCs (logistics + security) and their phone numbers
- Preferred room layout (theatre / u-shape / classroom) and whether whiteboards are available
- AV expectations: full-room video + gallery for remote execs, 1 wireless lapel, 1 handheld, 1 room mic?
- Any visitor access rules or badge provisioning lead time (we have folks who need door access)
- Dietary restrictions for onsite lunches

We plan to bring: 1 AV tech (Redwood), spare laptop with HDMI/USB-C adapters, room-level failover for Webex/Zoom. I will circulate a short preflight checklist (attachment) and a basic venue diagram once you confirm dates.

If Aug 24–25 is available we’ll target that and start booking travel.

Thanks —
